articles.summary: Based on the pattern of GDPR enforcement actions involving connected system vulnerabilities, Salt Security has identified three capabilities regulators expect organizations to demonstrate.

articles.summary: Organizations are rushing to deploy AI agents, but many still lack a clear view of what those agents can access, which tools they can call, and which APIs they can trigger.
articles.title: Why API Visibility Is the Ultimate Defense for AI Agents

articles.summary: The launch of Salt Code extends Salt's Agentic Security Platform from runtime protection into the development lifecycle, giving organizations a complete security foundation that covers both how agentic systems are built and how they behave once deployed.
articles.title: Salt Security launches Salt Code

articles.summary: If agents are connected to APIs, attackers can use them to explore and exploit weak authorization paths faster. The API vulnerability was already serious. Agentic access makes it scalable.
articles.title: We Trained Cybersecurity Startups to Win POVs, Not Solve Problems

articles.summary: Nine in ten security leaders are concerned about the security risks introduced by AI-generated code, according to new research entitled AI Coding Assistants and the New Security Challenge from Salt Security.
articles.title: 9 in 10 Security Leaders Concerned About AI-Generated Code Risks
